objective: Keep delegated HCLI work inside the sovereign hawkingd process tree.

trigger.observed_failure: A client-spawned __delegate_exec Python process was reparented to pid 1 while waiting on the resident HTTP stream without an emitted unit or checkpoint.
trigger.recovery: hcli abort f0cf23dacdff --reason resident HTTP stream emitted no unit/checkpoint; preserve one-daemon production ownership

implementation.child_lifecycle: direct hawkingd child, no detached session, tracked and terminated/reaped during daemon shutdown
implementation.client_policy: A configured localhost:8011 endpoint never falls back to a detached client worker when its daemon image lacks the supervision route.

verification.command: python3 -m pytest -q hcli/test_daemon_delegation_supervisor.py hcli/test_delegate.py hcli/tests/test_serve_openai_surface.py hcli/test_hawkingd_daemon_name.py hcli/test_processes.py

claim_boundary: Staged source and focused tests only. The currently live hawkingd process image predates this endpoint, so live daemon-owned delegation requires a controlled restart. This receipt makes no model capability, TPS, or autonomous-write claim.
